_doc: Per-state speed switch (owner 2026-11-16; four speeds 2026-11-18). daily = at most one full run a day (the longest); 4h = at most every 4 hours; fast = the tested activity-correlated cadence (15 min in meetings, ~1 h when meetings are ahead, 3-6 h otherwise; 'normal' still accepted); instant = every scheduled tick outside quiet hours. The source's own floor always wins (PA export hourly, California daily). Change one word and merge: the jobs read it on the next tick and the site's freshness limits follow on the rebuild. Read by cadence.profile_for() and web/vite.config.ts.
